page_title: LEI 1-2 AST | Leicester v Aston Villa 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' David Coote is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is flagged for offside.
90+5' A shot from the edge of the box by Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
90+4' Steven Cooper (Leicester) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+3' Harry Winks (Leicester) has too much to say to the referee and is cautioned.
90+2' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Caleb Okoli walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kasey McAteer (Leicester).
90+2' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) sees a yellow card from David Coote after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+1' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

90+1' John McGinn (Aston Villa) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
90+1' The resulting corner from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is cleared.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

90' John McGinn (Aston Villa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) is brought on as a substitute for Wilfred Ndidi.
88' The game is interrupted as Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is flagged offside.
87' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

85' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Mads Hermansen shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
83' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Aston Villa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' David Coote shows a yellow card to Jamie Vardy (Leicester) for a tough tackle.
81' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
79' Here is a change. Jacob Ramsey is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lamare Bogarde leaves the pitch and Kosta Nedeljkovic (Aston Villa) comes on.
79' The free kick picks out James Justin (Leicester) in space, but his close-range header flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
78' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) takes a direct free kick.
78' Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Leicester have a free kick.
78' David Coote interrupts the game. One of the players from Aston Villa won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick is awarded to Leicester.
76' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Free kick. Aston Villa will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
74' A yellow card for a tackle by John McGinn (Aston Villa). David Coote doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
74' Today's referee David Coote rightly decides to book Caleb Okoli (Leicester) for his harsh tackle.
73' 1 - 2 Goal! Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:2.
73' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
68' Substitution. Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) in, Jordan Ayew out.
68' Substitution. Oliver Skipp makes way for Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester).
67' Steven Cooper has decided to substitute Issahaku Fatawu and he is replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester).
67' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
63' 0 - 2 Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) jumps for a cross and plants a brilliant header into the top right corner.
63' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by John McGinn (Aston Villa), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
63' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) replaces Amadou Onana.
61' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) replacing Ollie Watkins.
61' The free kick is taken by Victor Kristiansen (Leicester), but ball is cleared.

60' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left David Coote no option but to blow his whistle. Leicester will take a free kick.

57' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.

56' A wild pass somehow finds Caleb Okoli (Leicester) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
55' David Coote shows the yellow card to Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) for a heavy challenge.
55' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Aston Villa.
53' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
53' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee David Coote signals. Leicester have a free kick.
51' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
50' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) rises high to meet a cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and powers his header on goal, but the goalkeeper shows his agility and makes a save.
49' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
46' Referee David Coote blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
45+3' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

45+1' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. David Coote has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Leicester are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Oliver Skipp (Leicester) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
44' Harry Winks (Leicester) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
43' David Coote blows his whistle. Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) commits a foul after dangerous play. Leicester have been awarded a free kick.

41' Caleb Okoli (Leicester) latches on to a lofted pass from the free kick and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is saved by the excellent Emiliano Martinez.
40' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
38' David Coote blows his whistle as Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. A free kick has been awarded to Leicester.
34' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

33' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Mads Hermansen thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner.
29' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
28' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Ollie Watkins tees up Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Mads Hermansen.
27' It seemed like Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
26' Oliver Skipp (Leicester) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. David Coote didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
25' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
24' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
24' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
23' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) commits a foul and David Coote immediately signals a free kick. There is a free kick near the sideline to Leicester.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
22' John McGinn (Aston Villa) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Great save! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Mads Hermansen.

21' John McGinn (Aston Villa) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
16' Unai Emery is forced to make a change. Leon Bailey is unable to continue due to injury, Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) comes on.
16' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) was too forceful with his tackle and David Coote interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Aston Villa in a dangerous position.
15' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee David Coote saw the whole situation. Aston Villa will take a free kick near the side line.
14' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
12' A player from Leicester commits a rough challenge. David Coote blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Aston Villa have a free kick.
10' Harry Winks (Leicester) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
10' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and David Coote blows for a foul. Leicester get a free kick.
9' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
8' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but David Coote ignores the protests.
8' Rough tackle by Amadou Onana (Aston Villa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Leicester are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
7' David Coote has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jamie Vardy (Leicester). Aston Villa win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
5' One of the players from Aston Villa times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

2' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mads Hermansen comes off the line to clear the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Aston Villa will kick-off.
David Coote will supervise the game today.
